import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int from;
        int to;
        double length;

        Edge(int f, int t, double l) {
            from = f;
            to = t;
            length = l;
        }
    }

    static class Node {
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();

        void addEdge(int e) {
            out.add(e);
        }
    }

    static class Graph {
        List<Node> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();

        Graph(int nrNodes, int nrEdges) {
            nodes.resize(nrNodes);
            edges.resize(nrEdges);
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, double length) {
            Edge e = new Edge(from, to, length);
            edges.add(e);
            nodes.get(from).addEdge(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        List<Integer> findAugmentingPath(int source, int sink, double[] flow, double[] pathCap) {
            PriorityQueue<Pair> q = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingDouble(p -> -p.first));
            double[] capacity = new double[nodes.size()];
            int[] pred = new int[nodes.size()];
            Arrays.fill(pred, -1);
            List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();

            capacity[source] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
            q.add(new Pair(Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, source));

            while (!q.isEmpty() && capacity[sink] == 0) {
                double cap = q.peek().first;
                int n = q.peek().second;
                q.poll();

                for (int i = 0; i < nodes.get(n).out.size(); i++) {
                    int eIdx = nodes.get(n).out.get(i);
                    Edge e = edges.get(eIdx);
                    double eCap = e.length - flow[eIdx];

                    if (eCap > 0 && Math.min(cap, eCap) > capacity[e.to]) {
                        q.remove(new Pair(capacity[e.to], e.to));
                        capacity[e.to] = Math.min(cap, eCap);
                        q.add(new Pair(capacity[e.to], e.to));
                        pred[e.to] = eIdx;
                    }
                }
            }

            *pathCap = capacity[sink];
            int eIdx = pred[sink];
            while (eIdx != -1) {
                path.add(eIdx);
                eIdx = pred[edges.get(eIdx).from];
            }

            return path;
        }

        double maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
            Graph residual = new Graph(nodes.size(), 2 * edges.size());
            double[] flow = new double[2 * edges.size()];
            List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            double pathCap;
            double maxFlow = 0;

            for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                residual.addEdge(edges.get(i).from, edges.get(i).to, edges.get(i).length);
                residual.addEdge(edges.get(i).to, edges.get(i).from, 0);
            }

            path = residual.findAugmentingPath(source, sink, flow, new double[]{});
            while (pathCap > 0) {
                for (int i = 0; i < path.size(); i++) {
                    int eIdx = path.get(i);
                    int eRIdx = eIdx + 1;
                    if ((eIdx % 2) == 1) eRIdx = eIdx - 1;
                    flow[eIdx] += pathCap;
                    flow[eRIdx] -= pathCap;
                }
                path = residual.findAugmentingPath(source, sink, flow, new double[]{});
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < residual.nodes.get(source).out.size(); i++) {
                int eIdx = residual.nodes.get(source).out.get(i);
                maxFlow += flow[eIdx];
            }

            return maxFlow;
        }

        void printAll() {
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes.size(); i++) {
                Node node = nodes.get(i);
                System.out.print(idToString(i) + " has edges to : ");
                for (int e = 0; e < node.out.size(); e++) {
                    System.out.print(idToString(edges.get(node.out.get(e)).to) + " ");
                }
                System.out.println();
            }
        }
    }

    static class Room {
        int i, j;
        boolean[] infected = new boolean[61];
        boolean[] accessible = new boolean[61];
        int scientists, capsules;

        Room() {
            scientists = 0;
            capsules = 0;
            Arrays.fill(infected, false);
            Arrays.fill(accessible, true);
        }

        int getNodeId(int timestamp) {
            return 2 + i + 10 * j + 100 * timestamp;
        }

        void setReactor() {
            Arrays.fill(accessible, false);
        }

        void setInfected(int timestamp) {
            if (accessible[timestamp]) {
                accessible[timestamp] = false;
                infected[timestamp] = true;
            }
        }

        void spreadInfection(int timestamp) {
            if (infected[timestamp]) {
                setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i > 0) floorplan[i - 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (i < 9) floorplan[i + 1][j].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j > 0) floorplan[i][j - 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
                if (j < 9) floorplan[i][j + 1].setInfected(timestamp + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static Room[][] floorplan = new Room[10][10];

    static String idToString(int id) {
        if (id == 0) return "source";
        if (id == 1) return "sink";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        int row = (id - 2) % 10;
        int col = ((id - 2 - row) % 100) / 10;
        int timestamp = (id - 2 - row - col * 10) / 100;
        sb.append("(").append(row).append(",").append(col).append(",").append(timestamp).append(")");
        return sb.toString();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        String[] input = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(input[0]);
        int t = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);

        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                floorplan[i][j] = new Room();
                floorplan[i][j].i = i;
                floorplan[i][j].j = j;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') floorplan[i][j].setReactor();
                else if (c == 'Z') floorplan[i][j].setInfected();
                else floorplan[i][j].scientists = c - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if ((c != 'Y') && (c != 'Z')) floorplan[i][j].capsules = c - '0';
            }
        }

        for (int c = 0; c <= t; c++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                    if (c < t) floorplan[i][j].spreadInfection(c);
                }
            }
        }

        Graph g = new Graph(10 * 10 * (t + 1) + 2, 100 * 4 * 60);
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                Room room = floorplan[i][j];
                if (room.scientists > 0) g.addEdge(0, room.getNodeId(0), room.scientists);
                if (room.capsules > 0) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(t), 1, room.capsules);
                for (int c = 0; c < t; c++) {
                    if (room.capsules > 0) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), room.getNodeId(t), 1000);
                    if (room.accessible[c]) {
                        if (i > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i - 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (i < 9) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i + 1][j];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j > 0) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j - 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                        if (j < 9) {
                            Room other = floorplan[i][j + 1];
                            if (other.accessible[c]) g.addEdge(room.getNodeId(c), other.getNodeId(c + 1), 1000);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        pw.println(g.maxFlow(0, 1));

        pw.close();
    }
